**By actor view finalizes #882's governance surface**

buildActorsModel merges snapshot's actors and reviews sections into one row per actor, humans and agents in one table under one schema, sorted by name only. reviewsPosted always carries the open-PRs-only caveat (#880 is still open); prsMerged is always the stated-absence shape {ok:false, reason:'no data source today'}, never a bare 0. Fixed renderDecisionRow/renderAntiPatternRow/renderHistoryEvent (PR2-4's hand-built el('span','source',...) dropped the sourceStamp's 'open ↗' chip on any forge-linked source) to go through renderSourceStamp, same as renderActorRow. GOVERNANCE_PLACEHOLDERS is now fully null; views-owned.test.mjs's forbidden-identifier test (from #998) is finalized into a presence proof for all five governance sub-views. Counted diff 194/1000; full suite 5911/5911.
